text:
sam: quick sync 1: thinking about guardrails for min/max + pool affinity. fig link: https://www.figma.com/file/Example-Guardrails

meera: main customer problem: teams accidentally set max too low, then see silent fallbacks -> surprising latency/cost. guardrails should make tradeoffs explicit.

diego: idea: two-mode cap control next to Max: [Soft cap] / [Hard cap]. soft = allow short bursts and charge; hard = strictly block scale beyond max.

lucy: microcopy options: 'Soft cap — allow temporary bursts (billing applies)' vs 'Hard cap — block scaling beyond this value (requests queue/fail)'. which reads clearer?

aria (a11y): accessibility: slider needs aria-valuetext combining mode and value, e.g., "Soft cap, 12 GPUs". avoid color-only status for chips. ensure focusable controls and keyboard +/- support.

ben: backend note: soft cap needs burst budget tracking and an endpoint for "burst remaining". we can surface a small token counter under the slider.

sam: ux: live cost preview under the slider that updates while dragging: "Est. compute: $X/hr at current max". show low/med/high chips with text labels, not color-only.

meera: tiny nit: prefer 'Min GPUs (reserved)' instead of 'kept ready' for clarity.

lucy: agree. reserved maps better to billing semantics.

diego: pool affinity toggle suggestion: multi-select pools with compatibility dots (quantization, KV cache). also show a compact "horizon" summary indicating which pool will handle burst.

aria (a11y): horizon legend must use patterns + text labels. compressed alt text for screen readers, e.g., "80% requests <200ms, 15% between 200-500ms, 5% >500ms".

ben: question: if chosen pool can't meet SLO at current max, do we block save? engineering prefers allow+warning. UX prefers guiding to safe action. compromise: allow save but surface strong warning banner with CTAs: 'Increase max', 'Pick alt pool', 'Save anyway'.

sam: banner copy draft: "Warning: Selected GPU pool unlikely to meet 95th percentile target at current Max GPUs. Suggested actions: Increase Max to X, or select [alt-pool] (est. +18% cost)."

meera: CTA priorities: primary should be a safe fix (Increase max or Pick alt pool). Save anyway needs a confirmation modal.

aria (a11y): confirmation modal must be keyboard accessible and announce consequence text. buttons need clear focus and descriptive labels.

lucy: design-bot: uploaded two variants (compact row vs expanded detail) at 1845010012. use compact for dashboard and expanded for route settings.

ben: timeline: dev spike next sprint. need final microcopy + a11y checklist before handoff.

sam: next steps: meera finalize copy by Wed, aria produce checklist, ben spec API fields for burst budget, diego mock compact horizon. thanks all. :rocket:
